title: SIP Calculator
h1: SIP Calculator — Estimate Systematic Investment Returns
seoTitle: SIP Calculator — Free Online Mutual Fund Tool
description: Estimate the future value of a monthly SIP using expected return and years. See total invested, estimated corpus and gains. Runs privately in your browser.
intro: Enter your monthly investment amount, expected annual return percentage and investment period in years. Instantly see how much your systematic investment plan could grow to.
blurb: Estimate the future value of a monthly SIP with compound growth.
howItWorks: Enter the amount you plan to invest every month.
Provide the expected annual rate of return and the number of years.
Click Calculate to see the projected corpus, total amount invested and wealth gained.
examples: Investing ₹5,000 per month at 12% for 10 years grows to roughly ₹11.6 lakh.
Compare different monthly amounts or tenures to plan a goal.
Use a conservative return rate for more realistic long-term estimates.

faq.q: What formula does the SIP calculator use?
faq.a: It uses the standard future value of an annuity formula: FV = P × (((1 + r)^n - 1) / r) × (1 + r) where r is the monthly rate and n is the number of months.
No. The calculation is an estimate based on the constant return rate you enter. Actual mutual fund returns vary and are not guaranteed.

faq.q: Is any data sent to a server?
faq.a: No. All calculations run locally in your browser. Your investment figures stay private on your device.
